name: National Smoke & Outdoor Air Window release benchmark
hard_vetoes: AirNow observed AQI is recalculated, blended, or relabeled as proprietary AQI
Hourly modeled PM2.5 concentration is presented as an official AQI forecast or health advisory
A distant or arbitrary reporting area is silently presented as local
Failure of one source family destroys otherwise useful independent evidence
The canonical route or API becomes unintentionally indexable or changes an existing canonical URL
The tool publishes thin city pages where geography does not materially change live evidence
A recommendation is shown with no confidence or provenance state
Release tests or benchmark score are below threshold
regression_scenarios: Bay City, MI — nearby PM2.5 observation and normal forecast path
Minneapolis, MN — smoke-prone Upper Midwest path
Denver, CO — western smoke and elevation market path
Seattle, WA — Pacific Northwest smoke path
Phoenix, AZ — ozone may dominate overall AQI but smoke tool stays PM2.5-specific
Miami, FL — low-smoke/no-nearby-fire context remains useful
AirNow unavailable — NOAA hourly guidance survives with lower confidence
NOAA PM2.5 guidance unavailable — current AirNow AQI survives with lower confidence
NWS weather unavailable — core air decision survives without wind
FIRMS key absent or request failed — fire context degrades without blocking result
No usable PM2.5 observation and fewer than three model samples — true insufficient-evidence response
